events.text: Cold-path implementation: generated fill thumbnails now use one packed grid Effect on the exact canonical FILL_SHADER pipeline; page slots retain Pressable identity, while Road/Cutout/Mission/imported WGSL keep per-cell fallbacks. Fixed 8x6/48 display contract unchanged. Focused pack/cache tests and standalone naga WGSL validation are green; full ReleaseFast gate pending.

resolution: Removed the shader browser's remaining cold-open/page burst without reducing its fixed 8x6/48-cell display. Generated fill recipes now pack variable material rows into one grid-routed Effect; the grid and ordinary selected-material preview use the exact same canonical FILL_SHADER source, so there is one 409-material pipeline compile rather than a second grid compile. Page slots retain Pressable identity, preserving independent tooltips/clicks while avoiding 48-node teardown/recreation; different-WGSL recipes remain correct through a sparse per-cell fallback (page 1 is batch + Road, pages 2-8 are one Effect, the last built-in page is batch + Cutout/Mission). Packed rows validate at the boundary, explicitly terminate empty palettes, and compare by value so unrelated parent renders do not dirty the StaticSurface. Verified with 5/5 focused tests, existing ShaderThumb cache tests, naga validation of the fully assembled WGSL, docs-index bundle, and a full ReleaseFast editor build. User visual/paging and 60s spikewatch confirmation requested in review.
